wasmSize.method: Raw WASM from exact frozen packages; gzip level9, Brotli quality11 generic mode. Compression bytes are storage/transfer diagnostics, not runtime allocation or latency.

limitations: Diagnostic only; no new full performance release gate or JS parity claim.
Nine three-way trials per row, 500 ms warmup, max128 operations per batch; shared browser/page heaps and caches.
Paired percentages are median(candidate[i]/control[i])-1. Family/stage aggregates are medians of row percentages, not pooled samples or causal estimates.
All adverse parse and retained controls are retained; no subtraction or noise/regression-free claim.
Harness verifies complete SVG and Object.is dimensions before/after. Report keeps check byte lengths and checksums, not the complete SVG; public E2E reports separately retain full results and counts.
Three-way positions balance 3/3/3 per runtime; control precedes candidate in 5 of9 trials per row. Raw execution orders are implied by the frozen harness, not recorded separately.
Swift evidence is fresh correctness using identical dense native inputs/SDK/binary. C3 is reused prior identical-native validation. No Swift performance or new native build claim.
WASM gzip/Brotli sizes are compressed-file diagnostics, not live memory or runtime latency.

Full405 browser correctness and immutable640deee source binding are separate from a performance release gate. Eighteen same-package profiles are diagnostic samples, not paired latency or an isolated before/after profile comparison.
